trial_court: MAT Suit No. 200 of 2011 by learned Additional District Judge, 5th Court, Barasat, 24-Parganas (North)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: husband and for opposite party in C.O. 457/13
parties.respondent_defendant: wife and for opposite party in C.O. 3678/12

facts_of_case: The wife took out an application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act and prayed for alimony pendente lite. The court passed the impugned order in favour of the wife. Both sides have come before the court.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking alimony to prove their income and expenses.
legal_principles.held: There is no specific document to show wife's income. There is no document to show that she is collecting Rs. 10,000/- per month from any person, her alleged tenant.

legal_principles.principle: The court may enhance or reduce alimony pendente lite based on the changed circumstances.
legal_principles.held: It may be enhanced. It may be reduced.

outcome.final_order: The husband to pay a sum of Rs. 10,000/- per month towards alimony pendente lite of the wife from the date of filing the application, i.e. from 06-07-2012.
